references.text: God made a covenant with Israel at Sinai and gave them laws and statutes, just as Joshua here renews the covenant with the people in Shechem.
God says that he will make a covenant with Israel, which reflects the covenant-making in Shechem.
Moses makes a covenant with Israel in Moab, parallel to Joshua's covenant-making in Shechem.
Moses wrote down the law and gave it to the priests and the elders, just as Joshua here establishes laws and statutes for the people.
The people make a covenant and commit themselves to follow God's law, a renewal of the covenant that Joshua established.
The new covenant in Christ fulfills and surpasses the earlier covenants made with Israel, including the covenant in Shechem.
